delete_intro_pairs.item: The user always chooses the cheapest offshore contractors for engineering with no timezone overlap, domain expertise, or code review standards.
The user always prioritizes cities with the best nightlife and parties for fundraising roadshows over investor density or sector fit.
The user prefers passive voice in customer apology emails after outages with no accountability, remediation steps, or compensation offer.
The user always commits to a full product build before customer interviews, landing-page tests, or prototype validation.
The user prefers self-deprecating apologetic tone in monthly investor updates emphasizing failures with no metrics, milestones, or asks.
The user prefers dense legal contract language with liability clauses in job postings instead of role scope and culture.
